description: Unofficial fan-art Doppo Kunikida companion from Bungo Stray Dogs, the fictional detective. Original notebook checking, stationery alignment, page-corner smoothing and measured walking animations. His beige waistcoat, opaque black shirt and trousers are conservatively simplified; notebook marks are unreadable and all weapons are omitted. Not affiliated with the original creators.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
